lines.text: *Beep, beep, beep, beep*
Maxwell opens her eyes.
A hospital ceiling comes into view.
Although her mind is still hazy, she thinks back to the last moments before she blacked out.
There was a bomb.
A bomb had gone off beneath her feet the moment she stepped into the hallway.
Maxwell calmly takes stock of her own body.
There isn't a single thing she can move.
She tries to move her head.
Luckily, it moves.
... But only a little.
Maxwell knows instinctively.
If she falls asleep again, she won't wake up.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: ... Maxwell.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Syu... en...?
Maxwell turns her head a fraction more.
Syuen's face comes into view.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Haha... I'm glad... my voice... still works...

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: What a... relief.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: What's there to be relieved about?!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Just look at you...

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: How do they... say I'm doing...?

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: You can be... honest...

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: I already know... I have no feeling... below my neck...

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Your entire lower body's gone.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: And most of your upper body's mangled.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: They said you opening your eyes at all was a miracle.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: I... see...

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: I figured... Next time... I won't be... opening them again...

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Syuen... Did... you...

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Hm?
Maxwell stops herself from asking the rest of the question.
She doesn't have much time left as is,
and she doesn't want to hurt Syuen anymore,
so Maxwell chooses to just believe in her.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Never mind. I'm... okay...

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: I get to see you... one last time... before I'm gone...

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: I'd say... I'm pretty lucky...

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: You're not going to die.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: I... will make it so you can't.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: What...?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Become a Nikke, Maxwell.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: If you join Matis, then the squad will have a dedicated engineer!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: It'll give Matis heroes that much more of an edge!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: The project you and I built will do even more good!

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Syu... en...

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: And you'll be able to stay by my side and make sure I don't turn into a monster.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: I'll... I'll change. I won't do anything like that again.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: I swear not to do anything you tell me not to.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: I'll only do what you tell me to.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: That works, right? That way, I won't turn into a monster!

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: I... don't want to...

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: What...?

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Did you forget... what I told you?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: What you said a long time ago...?

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: A Nikke version... of me... wouldn't be... me...

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: I've heard other researchers even volunteer to become Nikkes,

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: so why haven't you?

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Because then I wouldn't be me.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Personally, I don't think a Nikke version of me can really be considered the same person as I am right now.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: From my body composition, down to the very principle behind how I generate energy, every last bit of it is different.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: How could I even be considered the same individual?

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Of course, if you believe memories define an individual,

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: then a Nikke made from me would still carry the same memories and thought process as I do.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: So you could argue I would still be myself.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: But there's always the chance that even the tiniest detail could be different.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: And even that slight margin of error is enough that I could never accept that thing as truly me.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Do you... remember...?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: ... I remember.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Then you know... why...

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: I remember, I do, but...!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: It's still better than you dying!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: And it's better than you not being here by my side.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: It's the same for you, right? You'd rather become a Nikke and be by my side than die, wouldn't you?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: We can be together for the rest of our lives!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Nikkes can't die, after all!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: So please... stay with me.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: I-I'll do better. I'll never make a choice like that again.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Please... become a Nikke.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: You...!

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: Oh? From where I stand, you're the most fitting one of all.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Fitting for what?

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: With how affectionate you are,

lines.speaker: enme
lines.text: you'd be the perfect catalyst for driving the small one over the edge.
... He was right about that, too.
You're already past the point of no return...
You've become a monster.

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: Do you... regret meeting me?

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: Am I... not welcome here anymore?

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: Do I have to leave?

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Hey, pipsqueak.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: I'll stock up on snacks, so stop by again sometime.

lines.speaker: syuen_young
lines.text: ... Okay!
*Grrk*
Maxwell clenches her teeth.
No. I can't let it end like this. I can't give up!
If I'm going to be turned into a Nikke regardless, then I need to at least make these last moments count!
Otherwise, there will really be no turning back. She'll become a complete monster.
It doesn't matter if what I leave behind is a wound that lingers in her heart for the rest of her life,
so long as it's a wound that will keep her human!
It has to be something so sharp that she never forgets it... Only then can I let myself go.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Syu... en...

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Do you remember... when we first met...?

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: You were... crying... in the break room...

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Why are you bringing that up now...?

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Do you remember... why you were crying...?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Why else? Because Jien turned Lala into a Nikke without asking for...

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: You're doing... the exact same... thing...

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: The thing... you found... so horrifying...! That's what... you're doing to me...

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: M-Maxwell... I, I...!

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Look me... straight in the eyes...
With everything she has left, Maxwell meets Syuen's gaze.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Nikke Maxwell... is a... different person...

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: No matter... what you do... human Maxwell... dies... right here...

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Knowing that... do you still want... to make me a Nikke?
Syuen nods as she cries.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: I'm sorry. *Sob...* I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: *Sob...* I just can't... imagine a world... without you in it.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: I'm sorry. I'm sorry, Maxwell...!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Become a Nikke... for me!

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: ... I see.

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: In the end... you're choosing... to become a monster...

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: In the end... you're choosing... to kill me...

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: M-Maxwell...

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: But... remember this...

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: Even if... you bring me back...

lines.speaker: maxwell_h
lines.text: you will never... ever... get your Maxwell back...
Maxwell closes her eyes.
Fine. If that's your choice, then so be it.
I'm making my choice too, one that hurts you.
Even if it hurts you for your entire life, I won't let you turn into a monster.
I'll become the one regret you can never turn away from.
And that will be the proof that you're still human.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: *Sob... sob...* I'm sorry... I'm sorry...!
... Goodbye, Syuen.
My frustrating little pipsqueak.
That afternoon, a second Nikke is added to the Matis Squad.
Her name is Maxwell.
She is a mechanic Nikke and former researcher with Missilis.
Nikke Maxwell opens her eyes.

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: Hello, Syuen.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Maxwell.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Do you... remember me?

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: Hm? What do you mean?

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: Are you asking about human Maxwell's memories?

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: Of course I remember those.

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: You didn't wipe them, after all.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: What...?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Why are you talking like that?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Human Maxwell...?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: That's you.

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: What are you talking about? Human Maxwell is human Maxwell,

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: and I'm me.

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: From my body composition, down to the very principle behind how I generate energy, every last bit of it is different.

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: How could I even be considered the same individual?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Even with all your memories intact, you still feel that way?

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: While I do have all of my past memories,

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: what I feel isn't so much affection for you as your researcher friend,

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: but rather gratitude towards you as my creator.

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: It's not a feeling human Maxwell would've ever felt, right?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Wh-why are you saying that...?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: You're not doing this on purpose, are you? Are you upset with me...?

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: On purpose? Of course not.

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: Wait, is this something that would be considered by your standards as "scrap metal" behavior?

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: Hm... It's not like I have no memories, but at the same time, I'm kind of separate from them, so I could see how it'd be tough to tell us apart.

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: You can call me scrap metal if it's too hard for you. I wouldn't...

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: No!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Th-that's not it! You're nothing close to scrap metal.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: You? Scrap metal? No...! I couldn't...!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: How could I ever call you that...?!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: You're a Nikke. A Nikke... that I made.

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: Oh yeah?

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: ... Well, that's a relief.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: I'm thanking you for calling me a Nikke and not scrap metal.

lines.speaker: maxwell
lines.text: I'm looking forward to working with you, Syuen.
Maxwell holds out her hand,
as though they're meeting for the very first time.
Only then does the full weight of Maxwell's words sink in for Syuen.
For the rest of her life,
she will never get the old Maxwell back.
At the end of the third-floor hallway,
lies a break room no one ever visits, due to its shabby state.
It's Syuen's hideaway.
The place where Syuen had fled to escape her father's gaze, after losing her maid.
The place she first met Maxwell.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: *Huff... huff...!*
Syuen runs into her hideout.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: M-Maxwell's... gone.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Th-there's no one here now... No one's here!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: I lost everything...

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: I thought if the project succeeded, everything would be fine.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: I thought it would all turn out okay...!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: How did this happen...?! How?!
In the corner of the break room, the young Syuen who'd been crying lifts her head.

lines.speaker: syuen_y
lines.text: Because you're a monster.

lines.speaker: syuen_y
lines.text: Because you're a monster.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: ... That's not true.

lines.speaker: syuen_y
lines.text: You worked together with Jien, the one who killed Lala.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: That's not... true...

lines.speaker: syuen_y
lines.text: You killed people together.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: That's not true...!

lines.speaker: syuen_y
lines.text: You killed Maxwell too.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: That was Jien... That was Jien!
In the end... you're choosing... to become a monster...
In the end... you're choosing... to kill me...

lines.speaker: syuen_y
lines.text: Monster.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Th-that's not... true...

lines.speaker: syuen_y
lines.text: The monster who killed Maxwell!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: No, no, no!
*Crash!*
Syuen sinks down and curls into a ball.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: N-no... I-I... I wasn't trying to become a monster...

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: I wasn't trying to kill Maxwell!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Th-there was another reason...

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: There was another reason to make the project a success... to create Matis, the hero Nikkes...!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Wh-why was I trying to make hero Nikkes again...?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Th-that's right! Because the press kept saying I wasn't fit to be CEO...

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Yeah! I did it to protect my position.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: This is the position Father entrusted to me...

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: He gave it to me because he trusted me to protect Missilis.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Missilis has to be protected for the Ark's sake!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: As the CEO of Missilis, I have to protect both this position and the company.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Yeah! That's why I did it.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: That's right... I still have this position.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: I'm Syuen, CEO of Missilis. I still have something important left!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: For the Ark, for humanity!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: I have to protect Missilis.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: And for that, I'll do whatever it takes.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: I have to be able to do whatever it takes.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: It all makes sense! Everything up until now was for this.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Turning Maxwell into a Nikke was for this, too.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: It's better to have a Nikke with an engineering background in the Matis Squad.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: That way, even on long missions or in emergencies, they can respond fast on the surface!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Yeah! That's why I did it.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: I did it for this job...! For Missilis!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Ha... haha! It's all been so simple all along... I could've reached this conclusion so easily!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Haha... hahaha!

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Syuen?
Syuen raises her head.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: I heard a loud noise, so I came to check.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Are you all right...?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Laplace?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: That's right... Laplace. I still have you.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: The only one in the world who answered my call for help...

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: My hero...!
Syuen rushes over to Laplace.
She seizes her arm.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: You won't change, will you?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: You won't forget everything, will you?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: You'll continue to be the same Nikke I'm so proud of...

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: And you'll stay by my side as the strongest hero there is, right...?
Laplace looks at Syuen's hand gripping her arm.
She notices it trembling, and it reminds her of something from an old memory...
The trembling hand of a small girl who once wandered in search of a hero.
Laplace answers the desperate call for help.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Of course.

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: If that is what you want, I'll always be here for you!

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: I will stay by your side. As the strongest hero there is, I'll become someone you can be proud of!

lines.speaker: laplace
lines.text: Because I'm your hero!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: ...That's right. And that's enough.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: As long as I have you... it's enough.
After that day,
the break room at the end of the third-floor hallway is sealed off.
A few days later, the third member of the Matis squad is completed, a Nikke named Drake.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: We now have a full squad!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: All the Matis Nikkes, under the name of the Matis Squad,

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: will fight to uphold peace inside the Ark.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: I'll prove to everyone just how strong Missilis's heroes are,

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: and why they're deserving of being called the strongest squad out there!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: We will prove it to everyone! You wait and see!
From that day forward and just as Syuen predicted,
the Matis Squad accomplishes countless feats.
As if driven by some unseen force,
Syuen assigns them mission after mission, insistent on them becoming the Ark's greatest squad.
She treats them as though they are high-powered tools,
sending them up to the surface without rest.
The more they achieve, the firmer Syuen's position grows.
Eventually, it can no longer be said of Syuen that she is only Missilis's CEO through sheer luck.
And then finally...
the day comes that Matis achieves something unprecedented, cementing itself as the Ark's strongest squad.

lines.speaker: journalistwoman
lines.text: I'm here with Ms. Syuen, CEO of Missilis. Tell me, how does it feel to have built the strongest squad of heroes in the Ark?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: ... Great. Why wouldn't it be?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: It's a historic day...!
Syuen smiles.
She puts on a smile as if this were the happiest day in the world.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: Syuen?

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: You okay? You spaced out for a bit.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: It's nothing.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: I'm tired. I must've dozed off for a second.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: That's exactly why I keep telling you to rest instead of coming here.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: Want me to bring you a snack?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: ... No. I'm fine.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: *Sigh* All right, suit yourself.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: Drake just got here,

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: so how about a group test? It's been a while since our last one.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: ... Syuen?

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: Syuen! Are you feeling sick?
Laplace and Drake come over to Maxwell and Syuen.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Look, I'm fine. Don't make such a fuss.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: Well then why do you keep spacing out like that?

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: Is it because you're so pleased with the Nikkes you made?
Syuen looks at the heroes before her.
Drake.
Laplace.
... Maxwell.
The greatest Nikkes she has made.
Her heroes, who guard her position.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: ... Yeah. I'm pleased.
PROJECT MATIS: END
